  • 1. Supaṇṇavagga 1. Phoenixes

Suddhikasutta Plain Version

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Catasso imā, bhikkhave, supaṇṇayoniyo. “Mendicants, phoenixes reproduce in these four ways. Katamā catasso? What four? Aṇḍajā supaṇṇā, jalābujā supaṇṇā, saṁsedajā supaṇṇā, opapātikā supaṇṇā—Phoenixes are born from eggs, from a womb, from moisture, or spontaneously. imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso supaṇṇayoniyo”ti. These are the four ways that phoenixes reproduce.”

Paṭhamaṁ.
